newsitem.title: INDIA: India clears Ispat Telecom Holding's joint venture.
newsitem.headline: India clears Ispat Telecom Holding's joint venture.

text.p: The Indian Industry Ministry on Thursday approved Ispat Telecom Holding Pvt Ltd's proposal to set up a joint venture with foreign equity of 490 million rupees ($13.7 million).
The ministry said in a statement that the joint venture, with a foreign equity holding of 48 percent, will invest in infrastructure projects.
It also approved proposals of Ispat Communication Pvt Ltd and Ispat India Telecom Pvt Ltd to set up joint ventures to invest in infrastructure projects.
Both joint ventures will have a foreign equity holding of 48 percent and foreign investment of 490 million rupees each, it said.
The statement did not provide the name of the foreign investors.
